method: offline route extraction from the immutable image with network disabled, source inspection on the clean backend worktree, and frontend consumer scan

verified_consumers.frontend: useDashboardData selects /api/v1/jobs/search for every key present in CORE_SOURCE_BY_KEY; the nine historical urlPath values remain in configuration but are not selected
verified_consumers.backend_runtime: main.py is the only versioned runtime registrar of the nine historical routers
verified_consumers.other_versioned_clients: none found outside routers, main.py and tests
verified_consumers.external_clients: not disproved by runtime logs; preserve all 56 HTTP routes until an explicit deprecation decision

core_contracts_already_implemented.dispatch: POST /v1/harvest/sources/{source}/runs, harvest:write, required Idempotency-Key, 202 accepted, 409 while a scope lease is live

minimum_implementation_after_formal_roll.module: one cohesive Portfolio router module backed by services.core_http.default_client_factory
minimum_implementation_after_formal_roll.registration: include one compatibility router from main.py and remove the nine source-specific imports/registrations
minimum_implementation_after_formal_roll.configuration: one immutable per-source mapping containing public key, Core key, display name, route families and the existing 200/300 recent-item cap
minimum_implementation_after_formal_roll.transport: reuse the existing authenticated Core client factory; do not add a dependency or a new port hierarchy
minimum_implementation_after_formal_roll.recent: map bounded aggregate items to the existing public job keys; prefer apply_url over url and published_at over first_seen_at, retaining source-specific job_type/job_types fields
minimum_implementation_after_formal_roll.counts: shape locations, tags, companies, categories, job_types, cantons and remote/onsite directly from aggregate.counts with existing top_n bounds
minimum_implementation_after_formal_roll.refresh: retain get_current_admin_user, forward or generate a per-request Idempotency-Key, translate Core 202 to the established 200 message and preserve 409
minimum_implementation_after_formal_roll.age: format corpus_updated_at with the existing Never updated / minutes / hours / days vocabulary
minimum_implementation_after_formal_roll.health: derive status from enabled/observed scopes, last_complete_at and max_consecutive_failures; preserve the existing key set without exposing provider or credential details

honest_contract_limits.success_rate: the legacy value measured page-request success inside an in-memory scraper and has no exact native equivalent; do not label a different ratio as the same measurement
honest_contract_limits.last_error: Core deliberately stores failure state without a raw provider error on source_harvest_runs; expose null when healthy and a stable generic failure code/message when failing
honest_contract_limits.top_n: Core caps each dimension at 500; production cardinality must be measured after deployment before claiming exact parity for unbounded historical by-location responses
honest_contract_limits.recent_identity: external_id is the compatible source identity; the public URL is apply_url when present, otherwise url

validation_before_deleting_old_modules: run contract tests for every one of the 56 method/path pairs and their query bounds
compare old fixture responses with the adapter for data and metadata keys, allowing only the documented native health semantics
prove POST requires an admin and maps accepted, busy, unavailable and malformed Core responses
prove the adapter performs no provider network request
probe all nine deployed sources after Core f29fd44 and require non-empty recent data where the source aggregate is non-empty
run the 12-window frontend check and confirm the dashboard still uses /api/v1/jobs/search
only then remove the 25 full modules and nine shared normalizer classes listed in code-simplification-baseline.json
frontend_cleanup_after_adapter_validatio: remove the nine unreachable historical urlPath values while retaining urlPath for the eleven locally owned sources; CORE_SOURCE_BY_KEY remains the single routing map
status: design verified; implementation prohibited until formal rollback closure by the agreed order
